audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer brands this HARD 8/10 with Swain winning every chart row, while the packet shows 55.43% Naafiri WR over 792 games and both packet chart and content give Naafiri all seven stages. The difficulty label contradicts every data source.
audit.why: Immobile drain mage with no escape; Naafiri's burst outpaces his soul-drain until he stacks items, and even then he needs E to land. Diff/tone/diffRating are mirror-coupled so I did not edit them — flagged as a question instead.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the data; diff label left for adjudication.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer rows said Swain while all seven content rows and the packet chart say Naafiri — a full-chart two-layer contradiction; the full whys under the Swain rows all described Naafiri winning.
audit.why: His E root (12s down to 10) is his only lock; whiff it and he has nothing. His R is a flat 120s and ramps — burst beats it before the drain pays.
audit.corrected: Sides flipped to Naafiri on all rows with adjusted ratings; whys rewritten where they carried misnames.

audit.whatIsWrong: Naafiri's dash miscredited to W ('W-E in', 'W all-in', 'W-E-pack all-in') across the content layer — kit puts the champion dash on R. Cooldowns field had no digit. Anti-heal (missing interaction) is already covered in report[8].
audit.why: Kit authority: R 110/95/80 dash with recast shield; W untargetable pack surge 26-18s. Swain E 12-10s, shorter during R; Q 7s to 3.
audit.corrected: Slots fixed, real cooldowns written, root-dodge framing preserved.
